# actions

End, Resume and Remove a session, the pane snapshot for dead sessions, confirm dialogs.

- Spec: `docs/features/actions/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/actions/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/sessions*.go
web: web/src/features/actions.ts
web: web/src/render/confirm.ts
web: web/src/render/dead*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/actions.spec.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.end` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/end`
- `sessions.resume` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/resume`
- `sessions.remove` — `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}`
- `sessions.pane` — `GET /api/sessions/{id}/pane`
- `ws.session-removed` — `sessionRemoved`
